title: Unity移动端高性能玉石材质
author: 方木君
license: No explicit open-source license found in article; attributed technique reimplemented as native nodes; source text/images are excluded from distribution.
limitations: No original complete Shader, parameter defaults, mesh, textures or lighting setup supplied.
Logical distance is a geometric approximation, not measured thickness or physical volume transport.
DepthDistance + LightDistance must be positive, MaxDist > MinDist, Pow > 0, nonzero light direction, invertible model transform.
Core is independent of light color, intensity, shadows and normal, as in the published function. Lit integration is newly authored.
No mobile/Pad/GPU benchmarks; article title is not performance evidence.
